facts.fact: The Rwanda Revenue Authority says RRA registers and issues a TIN at all its offices and headquarters to individuals, NGOs, joint ventures, successions and public institutions.
The Rwanda Revenue Authority says business registration through the RDB portal, integrated with RRA systems, provides a single unique TIN.

note: The TIN links a business to the platform, but nothing says how it is issued or registered.
Document states nothing this study asks.
Page mentions clearing taxes with RRA and a company TIN, but states nothing about a computerised taxpayer register.

facts.fact: Rwanda Revenue Authority says taxpayers log in to its website with their TIN and password to declare property tax, which implies a computerised register keyed on TIN.
